name: Honwichai  - tale of a tiger and a cow
original_name: หลวิชัย-คาวี - tale of a tiger and a cow
source:
A tiger cub and a calf, sworn brothers.

After leaving their master, they set off to make their own in the wide world.

Will they find true love despite the complex webs of human connection, or will their nature get in the way?

[From [url=https://karita0101.itch.io/honwichai]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只小虎和一只小牛，结拜兄弟。

离开主人后，他们踏上征途，去广阔的世界闯荡。

尽管人际关系复杂，他们能否找到真爱，还是他们的天性会阻碍他们？

[来自[url=https://karita0101.itch.io/honwichai]itch.io[/url]]
